UpdateUserRequestDTO.description: Request payload for updating an existing user

UpdateShiftRevenueEntryRequestDTO.description: DTO for updating existing or adding new revenue entries within a shift

id.description: ID of the existing revenue entry. If present, only amounts are updated (category is immutable). If omitted/null, a new entry is created.

entryCategory.description: Entry category (REGULAR, FLAT_RATE, WEEKLY). Required when adding a new entry (id is null). Ignored for existing entries.

flatRateTypeId.description: Flat rate type ID (optional for FLAT_RATE category when adding a new entry). Ignored for existing entries.

minDriverPayoutPerShift.description: Minimum guaranteed driver payout per shift in EUR

PercentageShareRemunerationResponseDTO.description: Response object for percentage share remuneration model

ShiftSettlementResponseDTO.description: Shift settlement snapshot containing totals for revenue, driver remuneration, and company share

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue earned in the shift in EUR

driverRemuneration.description: Total remuneration paid to driver in EUR

companyRemuneration.description: Total retained by company in EUR

CreateUserRequestDTO.description: Request payload for creating a new user

CreateUserResponseDTO.description: Response payload after creating a new user, containing the generated temporary password

mustChangePassword.description: Whether the user must change their password on next login

temporaryPassword.description: One-time temporary password generated for the user

CreateDriverRequestDTO.description: Request object for creating a new driver

remunerationConfigs.description: The internal remuneration models assigned to the driver

minDriverPayoutPerShift.description: Minimum guaranteed driver payout per shift in EUR

CreatePercentageShareRemunerationConfigD.description: Request payload for percentage share remuneration model

DriverResponseDTO.description: Response object representing a driver in the system

userId.description: ID of the linked user account (if any)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the driver was created

CreateDriverUserRequestDTO.description: Request payload for creating a driver user account

email.description: Optional login email. If omitted, the driver's contact email is used.

ChangePasswordRequestDTO.description: Request payload for changing user password

currentPassword.description: Current password of the logged-in user

UpdateDriverRequestDTO.description: Request object for updating a driver

DriverInfoDTO.description: Driver information in a report entry

RevenueReportEntryDTO.description: Single entry or grouped summary row in the revenue report

date.description: Date of the shift or grouped period

shiftId.description: ID of the shift (populated for detailed entries, null for grouped rows)

entryId.description: ID of the revenue entry (populated for detailed entries, null for grouped rows)

entryCategory.description: Category of the revenue entry (REGULAR, FLAT_RATE, WEEKLY)

entryCount.description: Number of revenue entries represented in this row

RevenueReportResponseDTO.description: Response object representing a detailed revenues report in the system

RevenueReportSummaryDTO.description: Overall financial summary totals for the revenue report
